title: Adobe MAX Sneaks Reveals 10 Experimental AI Tools for Creators
dek: From talking to AI characters to walking inside a single photo.

facts.label: AI research projects shown at Sneaks
Projects you can try in Labs Playground
Host of the MAX Sneaks 2026 show

caption:
What if you could audition an AI character just by chatting with it on a video call? 🎬

At Adobe MAX Sneaks 2026, Adobe Research showed 10 experimental AI projects across video, audio and images. Highlights include Project Screen Test for building consistent AI characters through conversation, Project Sight Span that turns a flat photo into an explorable 3D scene, and Project Sound Bender that pulls a described sound out of a finished mix.

None are shipping products yet, but Project Deep Brush and Project Hands On are already open to try in the new Adobe Labs Playground. Adobe says the focus is precision and control for creators, not one-click results.

We break down every demo at AI Parabellum. Which Sneak would you use first?

post_caption:
Adobe just gave creators a peek at the future of Photoshop, Firefly and Creative Cloud, and two of the tools are live right now.

Project Deep Brush and Project Hands On can be tested today in Adobe Labs Playground, while ideas like Live Set, On Cue and Rinse Repeat stay in the lab for now. ✨
